cover.subtitle: Sketches of Miles
cover.calloutLabel: A note from President and Executive Director
cover.pressQuote: A brilliant, cohesive unit that plays with fire and finesse—one of the most vital ensembles in jazz today. DownBeat

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: In celebration of Miles Davis' centennial, the award-winning all-women supergroup Artemis explores his monumental impact with reimagined arrangements largely drawn from his signature 1960s period—from introspective moods to free interplay and dramatic shifts.
body: RENEE ROSNES piano INGRID JENSEN trumpet NICOLE GLOVER tenor saxophone NORIKO UEDA bass ALLISON MILLER drums In celebration of Miles Davis' centennial, the award-winning band explores his monumental impact with reimagined arrangements largely drawn from the trumpeter's signature 1960s period. From introspective moods to free interplay and dramatic shifts, Artemis presents a fascinating look at the many moods of Miles.
